source_record.statement: Plan Build At binds exact Plan ID/version/hash.

rows.observed: The real Build At form stores Plan ID, current V1 and content-derived hash; scheduled admission consumes that exact binding.
rows.remaining: Noncryptographic concept hash, not canonical hashing or durable/provider proof.

source_record.statement: Plan revision invalidates its pending build schedule rather than retargeting silently.

rows.observed: Actual composer revision leaves the schedule at V1, invalidated. V2 is bound only through Use V2; V1 contents preserved.
rows.remaining: Arbitrary provider replanning, durable restarts and remote scheduler invalidation not proven.

source_record.statement: A scheduled build creates no PlanRun, Goal, CrewRun, To-Do work binding, or provider attempt until first eligible dispatch admission.
acceptance_criteria: The schedule is durable but execution has not started.
negative_constraints: Do not count scheduled work as active work.

rows.observed: Saving or early-ticking the one-time schedule creates no approved run, Goal, or To-Dos.
rows.remaining: Native PlanRun/Goal/Crew/provider admission and persistence are outside the HTML.

source_record.statement: At dispatch, the scheduler revalidates exact Plan version/hash/currentness, topology configuration, project/worktree, permission, provider/account/model, tools, window, and quota.
acceptance_criteria: Any unmet predicate yields Held or Failed with reason.
negative_constraints: Do not silently alter Plan, topology, account, or model.

rows.observed: Actual content/version recheck, local catalog route, worktree, permissions, quota and due time fences are exercised; negative counterexamples cause no admission.
rows.remaining: Tools, complete topology/config validation, native permission enforcement and durable Held/Failed projections remain open. Some local failures return exact refusal rather than persist Held.

source_record.statement: Immediate Build of the same Plan version atomically invalidates its pending schedule before admitting the run.
negative_constraints: Do not leave timer ownership ambiguous.

rows.observed: The independent immediate-Build counterexample invalidates only its pending schedule and a subsequent scheduled tick cannot duplicate work.
rows.remaining: Native atomic admission, race concurrency, and durable timer ownership not proven.

source_record.statement: Plan revision invalidates schedules bound to older versions; the user must explicitly update or recreate them.
acceptance_criteria: Schedule card identifies stale Plan version.

rows.observed: Visible stale V1-to-V2 notice, explicit V2 rebind and V2 admission; repeated revisions test rebinds the actual V3.

source_record.statement: Provider/model/account unavailability at dispatch follows the stored fallback policy; absent explicit fallback, the build is Held or Failed rather than substituted.
negative_constraints: Do not open a hidden modal or pick another route.

rows.observed: An unavailable locally catalogued model prevents dispatch without selecting a different route.
rows.remaining: Stored fallback policy, full requested/effective projection and persistent Held/Failed outcome are not closed.

source_record.statement: Canceling the Plan or its bound Goal/Crew invalidates only schedules and quota consent associated with that execution; unrelated scheduled messages remain.
negative_constraints: Do not globally clear a thread's schedules.

rows.observed: Cancel Plan invalidates its pending schedule; canceled records stay canceled; unrelated seeded schedules stay unchanged in guided tests.
rows.remaining: Goal/Crew association handling, all quota-consent combinations and native persistence not proven.

source_record.statement: Editing a schedule uses expected revision/currentness and cannot mutate a schedule after dispatch has started.
negative_constraints: Do not race timer dispatch with user edits.

rows.observed: A stale editor revision is refused before any update.
rows.remaining: Full dispatch-vs-edit concurrency and durable transaction proof not exercised.

source_record.statement: Schedule and first-dispatch idempotency are distinct: repeated schedule creation returns one schedule, and repeated timer delivery admits one run.
acceptance_criteria: Both idempotency domains have independent tests.
negative_constraints: Do not use wall-clock time as the sole dedup key.

rows.observed: Replaying a submitted creation control creates no second schedule; repeated current-record clock ticks return one receipt and never create duplicate To-Dos/messages.
rows.remaining: Durable request-key idempotency, network retry reconciliation and concurrent service delivery are not proven.

source_record.requirement: A canceled schedule must not dispatch. Cancellation and immediate Build must invalidate the appropriate pending scheduled action without removing unrelated schedules.
source_record.acceptance: Cancel before deadline, cancel/dispatch race, immediate Build, repeated clicks, revision/version rebinding.

rows.observed: Canceled schedule due-time preview cannot create a build or To-Dos; immediate Build invalidation and repeated controls are independently checked.
rows.remaining: True concurrent cancellation/dispatch race and native runtime not tested.

source_record.requirement: Separate scheduled messages, execution/build windows, resume/safety, and event history. Distinguish needs-attention, upcoming, inactive and terminal records. At a glance show the action, destination, local time/timezone, status and available next action; keep technical snapshot/log fields behind Details.
source_record.acceptance: One-time/recurring/held/failed/canceled/sent states; no explanatory wall; no ambiguous run versus message identity.

rows.observed: Build At is one direct form with a focused single-record follow-through; date/time/zone and action hierarchy are shown.
rows.remaining: The other Schedule Manager categories and every status/workflow are outside this batch.

scope: Three one-time agent-topology concept workflows; no native dispatch.
